description: How it works (Build.Rite): every flow of the team's tools — Issues, Code fix, Application pages, Jira stories and AI analysis, the FDD library, standup minutes, follow-ups, the data branch, the AI — step by step: who does each step (you, the AI, the agent, the app, git, Jira), its side paths, where what it makes is kept, and a button to open it. Watch the flow plays it as an animation: the steps on a path, a dot travelling along it, the step shown large, what it makes collecting as it goes, then its other ways and where it is kept. Its words are in resources/js/flowsGuide.js.

playId.description: The flow being watched ('' when none).

playStep.description: Its step on show (from 0); its last + 1 is the end (its other ways, where it is kept).

playTick.description: The animated flow's clock (resources/js/flowPlayer.js): the next step.
